'''2017 Worlds Day 2 Tom Marlin LS You Can Either Profit By This''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Tom Marlin]] at [[2017 World Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Tom Marlin]]
* '''Event:''' [[2017 World Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
